notes.title: New Version Release!! 2018 The First Quarter new update!!
notes.notes:
New upgrade for version(V2.0.5)
After these few months we had build a mobile version for GearVR, Yeah!! 
If you are using SamSung Mobile for GearVR, please login your oculus home app and Download MermaidVR. New mobile VR experience is waiting for you!! Thank you!!
Pay attention! Above is just our AD work for our new mobile version on GearVR. 
; )  Hope you don’t mind, We need your supporting!

Ok, Now there are the points for MermaidVR PC version (V2.0.5)

We fixed some miner bugs...improve our user experience.
We update our website www.mermvr.com, you can download a PC version of MermaidVR, Both support HTC VIVE & Oculus RIFT & Odyssey without login store app.
Cinema Mode after select a seat without any other click, it will auto confirm after 10 secs.
Improve video coding support.
Improve Subtitle display option.
Allow user use just one controller for MermaidVR.


Thank you for your suggestion and idea, we are trying to build the new function which is your ideas or suggestion. Thank you for your support all the time.
 This new version will release this weekend. Hope you will enjoy MermaidVR.

notes.title: Happy New Year !!MermaidVR new version also get ready for you!!!
notes.notes:
New upgrade for version (V2.0.2)
Happy New Year my friends!!!Enjoy the VR world with MermaidVR, it is the best choice in holiday.We will give these news for you.

 www.mermvr.com updated new content.
 New Function: Happy Brainwashing Mode. Now you can single repeat current video forever.
This idea came from our discussions, thank you and hope you will enjoy looping your relaxing videos.
 New Function: Looping Mode, repeat all videos in the same file path. you can choose to repeat all videos without stop, enjoy it!
 Fixed: About new function, video format inheritance, we found that it may not easy for  new user, so we delete it. When you play a new video(never play by MermaidVR), default format is 2D video, you can choose to change the setting by control panel. The old video(that you have play by MermaidVR once), the format still have record.
 New Design: Mermaid Browser change to Curved, viewing is wider and bigger.
 Fixed: Improve the determine of the drag distance, so now it is not easy to click the file when you just want to drag and browse folder.


The New version (V2.0.2)will publish as soon as possible.
We hope you will enjoy MermaidVR and Happy New Year. 
2018 Please keep support MermaidVR.Thank you ;)

Cheers,
Johnson

notes.title: New upgrade for Version (V2.0.1)
notes.notes:
New upgrade for Version (V2.0.1)
Long time no see, my friends. Over one month, without any update & news. Do you miss us? 
Anyway,I miss you guys so much.
Yeah..We are preparing the New Version and forgot about the time.
Before everyone busy on Black Friday.
We had developed some new functions for you.
Let me show you what will you get from MermaidVR (V2.0.1) 

We had build our website: www.mermvr.com. It will include more and more popular VR resources website. User would easy to look for any VR video recourse and VR news.
New function: A new VR Browser of MermaidVR. It is prefect for HTC & Oculus VR. 
Handle keyboard for VIVE. New design new choice.
Support the Browser displays switch back and forth between PC desktop & VR. 
The screen on PC desktop could be hided or showed. User can choose show or hide their playing screen by setting, protect your privacy.
New 3D background, more and more background choices for you. Make you feel into a different virtual environment
Support download file on Internet, and provide functions like multithread downloading, downloading progress and state management, watching while downloading, and continuing transfer from breaking point.


The New version (V2.0.1) will publish around next week.
We hope you will enjoy MermaidVR. Please keep support us.

Cheers,
Johnson

notes.title: Big Announcement about Version(V1.0.4)
notes.notes:
Big Announcement :

After upgrade to the newest version(V1.0.4) there are a few probabilities appeared that it is no menu or no screen display on the app.
Actully there is a minor error about the uesr database.
Gratefully that just few of user may appear this issue, if you are the lucky one, please don't be nervous.
Calm down and listen to me please.

1.  Find out this file on your computer:
C:\Users\xx(your user name)\AppData\LocalLow\MERMAIDVR INC\MermaidVR\PlayerSqlite.db

2.  Boldly delete it!!
Delete the PlayerSqlite.db

3.  Relaunch MermaidVR Video Player
Yeah, everything is perfect now!

Thank you for your reading, and next version we will fixed this issue.
The uesr database included the user personal record,we need careful handling.

Cheers,
Johnson
